messages:
sam_sales: Hey team — Acme (PoCExpress) getting 403 on generate endpoint, says project claim mismatch. Customer hit this during demo. Can someone triage?

bob_acme: getting \"403 Forbidden: project claim does not match request\" when I call /v1/generate. Using the API key we were given in the portal.

sam_sales: thx. Can you paste the curl you ran (sanitized key)?

bob_acme: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk.test.XXXX\" -H \"X-Redwood-Project: acme-demo\" -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","input":"hello"}'

elaine_se: quick sanity check — the project header needs to match the project bound to the key (case-sensitive). Also we recently tightened org->project binding for trial keys.

michael_infra: I see in logs: 
```
authz: key=sk.test.XXXX bound_project=acme-trial tenant=acme-org
request: header_project=acme-demo
decision: DENY (project mismatch)
```
Looks like portal issued a key bound to acme-trial not acme-demo.

sam_sales: ok — did the portal create a shadow project for demos? customer thought the key was for their demo project.

elaine_se: sometimes presales flow creates a temporary project name (acme-trial). The fix: either call with X-Redwood-Project: acme-trial or swap project binding on the key. We can't silently relax authz.

bob_acme: if we change header to acme-trial it works?

paul_support: can you try: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk.test.XXXX\" \
  -H \"X-Redwood-Project: acme-trial\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","input":"hello"}'
```

bob_acme: that returned 200! Thanks. But how do we avoid this mismatch for our engineers? They expect the portal project name.

michael_infra: filing a small portal bug — presales keys show both bound project and the friendly demo name. In the short term we can rebind the key to acme-demo or issue a new key with correct binding.

sam_sales: rebind please — customer prefers not changing all their code. Also they asked about rate limits earlier — during load demo they hit intermittent 429s. Any correlation?

michael_infra: checking metrics — their trial key is on the free-tier rate window (60rpm) and we saw spikes reaching 95rpm during parallel demo scripts. 429s are expected. We should recommend reserve capacity or a higher trial throttle for demo windows.

elaine_se: we can temporarily uplift the quota for the account for the remainder of the demo. I'll approve a one-off upsell credit (internal note).

sam_sales: customer also asked about pricing for steady 10 qps sustained usage. Can we give a quick ballpark?

paul_support: pricing note: hosted API usage tiers — typical per-token pricing, but for committed throughput (dedicated) we give capacity-based commits. For 10 qps sustained on redwood-medium, rough estimate $Xk/month — I'll DM finance for exact quote.

bob_acme: last thing — our security team wants confirmation that keys are org-bound and cannot be used outside project. Also they want an audit log for who rotated the key.

michael_infra: keys are bound to tenant/org+project. We'll provide audit logs (we log key mint + rebind + rotate events with actor). I'll attach the audit link to the ticket.

elaine_se: resolution plan: 1) temporary quota uplift for demo window (approved) 2) rebind existing key to acme-demo OR issue new key bound to acme-demo (customer prefers rebind) 3) share audit logs and security blurb 4) pricing ballpark and follow-up for dedicated commit if they want steady 10 qps.

sam_sales: I'll coordinate with Bob and confirm rebind. Bob — do you want us to rebind the key or issue a new one?

bob_acme: please rebind the key to acme-demo and confirm when done. Also please send the audit log and quota uplift timeframe.

michael_infra: done — rebind complete at ts=1754322400. Logged action id=act_9923.

ops_bot: Rebind action recorded: act_9923 by michael_infra at 2025-06-10T15:46:40Z.

michael_infra: quota uplift applied until 2025-06-10T18:00:00Z. Throttle now 300rpm for acme-org during uplift window.

bob_acme: confirmed generate calls succeed with original header (acme-demo) and 200/streaming. Great, thanks team!

sam_sales: awesome — I'll follow up with pricing and the security docs. Closing this triage. :thumbsup:
